+def _fill_missing_variable(var_name, var_template, dims_sizes, fill_value):
+    """
+    Create a variable filled with fill_value for missing data.
+    
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    var_name : str
+        Name of the variable
+    var_template : Variable
+        Template variable to get dimensions and dtype from
+    dims_sizes : dict
+        Dictionary mapping dimension names to their sizes
+    fill_value : scalar
+        Value to fill the variable with
+        
+    Returns
+    -------
+    Variable
+        A new variable filled with fill_value
+    """
+    import numpy as np
+    
+    # Get the shape based on the template variable's dimensions
+    shape = tuple(dims_sizes[d] for d in var_template.dims)
+    
+    # Create the filled data
+    if fill_value is dtypes.NA:
+        # Use NaN for floating point, or None for object dtype
+        if np.issubdtype(var_template.dtype, np.floating):
+            data = np.full(shape, np.nan, dtype=var_template.dtype)
+        else:
+            data = np.full(shape, fill_value, dtype=var_template.dtype)
+    else:
+        data = np.full(shape, fill_value, dtype=var_template.dtype)
+    
+    return Variable(var_template.dims, data, attrs=var_template.attrs)
